description: This Java source file defines the NotifyRespInd class, representing an M-NotifyResp.ind Protocol Data Unit (PDU) used in MMS messaging. It provides constructors and getter/setter methods to handle various fields such as report permission, status, and transaction ID within the MMS protocol.
